study type: retrospective comparative cohort study; qualitative framework analysis; mixed methods
outcome: maternal and perinatal mortality and morbidity
cohort: The study participants include pregnant women and their neonates who were transferred via ambulance to Manchester University NHS Foundation Trust (MFT) and a comparative group who were not, during pregnancy, birth, and the early postpartum period.
finding: This study aims to investigate health disparities in access to ambulance services during pregnancy, birth, and the early postpartum period and its association with maternal and neonatal outcomes.
